title: Therapeutic efficacy of Eugenol in ameliorating ovalbumin-induced allergic airway inflammation via HDAC inhibition and NF-kappaB downregulation in Asthma: In vivo and in silico analysis.
authors: Usmani, Kainat; Chakraborty, Kanak; Rajput, Devyani; Jain, Subodh Kumar; Yadav, Shweta
one_liner_zh: 该研究通过体内OVA哮喘模型和分子对接/动力学模拟评估丁香酚对HDAC1和NF-κB p65的抑制作用，但核心是药物小分子-蛋白互作，非蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合体系，仅方法可部分借鉴。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Asthma is a chronic inflammatory airway disorder characterized by persistent airway inflammation, oxidative stress, and airway remodeling. Eugenol, a major bioactive constituent of Syzygium aromaticum L. (clove), exhibits potent anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties and has been traditionally utilized in Ayurveda for respiratory ailments. Nevertheless, the comprehensive and precise mechanisms underlying its anti-inflammatory effects and antioxidant capabilities against asthma not yet have been completely understood. HYPOTHESIS/PURPOSE: The aim of the study was to investigate the therapeutic efficacy of Eugenol on OVA-induced asthma and to explore its underlying mechanisms. STUDY DESIGN AND METHODS: Swiss albino female mice were sensitized and exposed to OVA, following administration of Eugenol by oral gavage. Samples of bronchoalveolar lavage fluid (BALF), serum and pulmonary tissues were obtained at 48 h after the final challenge. Quantification of differential inflammatory cells in the BALF and measurement of inflammatory cytokine levels were performed using ELISA. Oxidative stress was assessed by measuring serum NO levels and lung tissue levels of MDA, GSH, SOD, and CAT. Additionally, serum creatinine was evaluated to monitor the systemic safety profile of Eugenol administration. The activation of HDAC1 and NF-kappaB p65 signaling was investigated by semi-quantitative analysis using immunohistochemistry. In addition, the lung tissues were stained using hematoxylin and eosin as well as Masson's trichrome stain for histopathological examination. The anti-inflammatory effect of eugenol was also examined via inhibiting HDAC1 and assessed their effectiveness in silico. The study incorporated molecular docking and MDS analyses to comprehensively evaluate the binding affinity, molecular interactions, and structural stability of eugenol with its target proteins. RESULTS: The administration of Eugenol treatment significantly reduced the expression of HDAC1 and NF-kappaB p65 in lung tissues. It showed antiasthmatic properties by lowering oxidative stress, decreasing MDA, and enhancing levels of GSH, CAT, and SOD. Moreover, it reduced the levels of inflammatory cytokines and nitrite in the serum of mice with acute OVA-induced asthma and ameliorated histopathological alterations. Molecular dynamics simulations conducted over 100 ns demonstrated the stability of the ligand-protein complexes, suggesting a robust connection. It also exhibited favorable docking scores of -5.70 kcal/mol with NF-kappaB p65 and -5.40 kcal/mol with HDAC1. The compound consistently formed complexes with the protein target in molecular dynamics simulations performed over 100 ns timeframe. The inhibitory potential of eugenol was confirmed by MM-GBSA estimates of free energy. Moreover, in silico investigations on the proposed strategy expand the therapeutic potential of eugenol in alleviating asthma symptoms. CONCLUSION: The study demonstrates that eugenol present in clove exerts anti-asthmatic benefits by inhibiting the HDAC1 and NF-kappaB p65 signaling pathway.
abstract_zh: 背景：哮喘是一种慢性炎症性气道疾病，其特征为持续性气道炎症、氧化应激和气道重塑。丁香油酚（Eugenol）是丁香（Syzygium aromaticum L.）的主要生物活性成分，具有强效的抗炎和抗氧化特性，并传统上在阿育吠陀医学中用于治疗呼吸系统疾病。然而，其抗炎作用和抗氧化能力对抗哮喘的全面且精确机制尚未完全阐明。假设/目的：本研究旨在探讨丁香油酚对OVA诱导哮喘的治疗效果，并探索其潜在机制。研究设计与方法：瑞士白化雌性小鼠经OVA致敏和激发，随后通过口服灌胃给予丁香油酚。在最后一次激发后48小时收集支气管肺泡灌洗液（BALF）、血清和肺组织样本。使用ELISA对BALF中的差异炎症细胞进行定量，并测量炎症细胞因子水平。通过测量血清NO水平以及肺组织中MDA、GSH、SOD和CAT水平来评估氧化应激。此外，评估血清肌酐以监测丁香油酚给药的全身安全性。通过免疫组织化学半定量分析研究HDAC1和NF-kappaB p65信号的激活。此外，肺组织用苏木精和伊红以及Masson三色染色进行组织病理学检查。还通过抑制HDAC1来检测丁香油酚的抗炎作用，并在计算机模拟中评估其有效性。研究结合分子对接和MDS分析，全面评估丁香油酚与其靶蛋白的结合亲和力、分子相互作用和结构稳定性。结果：丁香油酚治疗显著降低了肺组织中HDAC1和NF-kappaB p65的表达。它通过降低氧化应激、减少MDA并增强GSH、CAT和SOD水平，显示出抗哮喘特性。此外，它降低了急性OVA诱导哮喘小鼠血清中炎症细胞因子和亚硝酸盐的水平，并改善了组织病理学变化。在100 ns内进行的分子动力学模拟证明了配体-蛋白质复合物的稳定性，表明存在强健的连接。它还对NF-kappaB p65显示出-5.70 kcal/mol的有利对接分数，对HDAC1为-5.40 kcal/mol。该化合物在100 ns时间框架内的分子动力学模拟中持续与靶蛋白形成复合物。丁香油酚的抑制潜力通过MM-GBSA自由能估计得到确认。此外，对拟议策略的计算机模拟研究扩展了丁香油酚在缓解哮喘症状中的治疗潜力。结论：研究表明，丁香中的丁香油酚通过抑制HDAC1和NF-kappaB p65信号通路发挥抗哮喘益处。
